title: Belgrieve
summary: Belgrieve the Death Knight is a powerful Krono-Titan used by Ford. Deprived of eyes, Belgrieve is said to be guided by the aura of life in order to generate death.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Belgrieve was summoned by [[Ford]] to fight against [[Caliban]] in a secret tunnel at the [[Venice Preparation Academy]]. Belgrieve was at the upper hand and even broke Caliban's sword, however because it was high tide and the cave was filled with water, there was risk of drowning and Ford thought that the treasure was gone, Ford returned Belgrieve to its amulet and he and the other [[The Organization|Organization]] members retreated. {{Source|The School of Mystery}}

Belgrieve was later used in conjunction with [[Shifter]] during the carnival in [[Venice, Italy]], disguising him as [[Ryder]]. Chasing who he belived to be Ryder, Dante fought with Belgrieve before kicking the mask off revealing Shifter's illusion. Dante then invoked Caliban and the pair defeated both Belgrieve and Shifter. {{source|The Carnival of Deception}}

full_text:
Belgrieve the Death Knight is a powerful Krono-Titan used by Ford. Deprived of eyes, Belgrieve is said to be guided by the aura of life in order to generate death.

==History==
Belgrieve was summoned by Ford to fight against Caliban in a secret tunnel at the Venice Preparation Academy. Belgrieve was at the upper hand and even broke Caliban's sword, however because it was high tide and the cave was filled with water, there was risk of drowning and Ford thought that the treasure was gone, Ford returned Belgrieve to its amulet and he and the other Organization members retreated. [The School of Mystery]

Belgrieve was later used in conjunction with Shifter during the carnival in Venice, Italy, disguising him as Ryder. Chasing who he belived to be Ryder, Dante fought with Belgrieve before kicking the mask off revealing Shifter's illusion. Dante then invoked Caliban and the pair defeated both Belgrieve and Shifter. [The Carnival of Deception] 

== Abilities ==
Belgrive is extremely powerful Titan, able to fight on par with Caliban and break his sword. Although he cannot see, Belgrieve can sense his enemies and its lethal attacks keep them well away.
